children: Aspire Bi announced a corporate name change to Aspire-Lakewood Holdings, effective upon filing the Certificate of Amendment.
The board and stockholders approved renaming Aspire Bi to Aspire-Lakewood Holdings to reflect its evolving strategy.
Name change effective upon filing the Certificate of Amendment with the Delaware Secretary of State.
Nasdaq listing and ticker symbol ASBP remain unchanged; no action required by stockholders.
Company frames the change as aligning a holding company structure after acquiring Dura Control Systems Corp.
